episodes.title: The Principal
episodes.summary: When the principal of a high school retires, his two vice principals go to extremes to land the vacant job.

episodes.title: A Trusty Steed
episodes.summary: Gamby and Russell invade Dr. Brown's private space; a school evaluator spooks the vice principals.

episodes.title: The Field Trip
episodes.summary: Gamby looks to impress Amanda on a field trip organized by Mr. Hayden, a good-guy history teacher.

episodes.title: Run for the Money
episodes.summary: Gamby and Russell eye a homecoming football game as a way to further break Dr. Brown's spirit.

episodes.title: Circles
episodes.summary: Dr. Brown orders Gamby to lighten up on discipline; Russell copes with a disruptive neighbor.

episodes.title: The Foundation of Learning
episodes.summary: Amanda makes a deal with Gamby, while Dr. Brown takes a veteran teacher to task over a shipment of missing books.

episodes.title: The Good Book
episodes.summary: Gamby bonds with Amanda during teacher workday; Russell's patience is tested; Dr. Brown deals with the sudden appearance of her ex-husband, Dascious.

episodes.title: Gin
episodes.summary: Gamby and Russell stay the course with their plan. Meanwhile, Gamby wants to know the extent of Amanda's relationship with Bill.

episodes.title: End of the Line
episodes.summary: Gamby and Russell play their end game with Dr. Brown.

episodes.title: Tiger Town
episodes.summary: Recovering from his wounds, Gamby returns to a dramatically changed North Jackson High.

episodes.title: Slaughter
episodes.summary: Gamby identifies a suspect, with Dayshawn's help; Russell tests out a kindness strategy at school.

episodes.title: The King
episodes.summary: Gamby's hunt for his shooter leads him into a novelist's graduate-school class; Russell's ire is fueled by an unflattering caricature.

episodes.title: Think Change
episodes.summary: A death in Russell's family forces Gamby into the role of North Jackson's acting principal.

episodes.title: A Compassionate Man
episodes.summary: Russell's birthday bash is marred by a revelation about his wife's college boyfriend.

episodes.title: The Most Popular Boy
episodes.summary: A plot to sabotage a standardized test jeopardizes Russell's job as Gamby is caught in the middle.

episodes.title: Spring Break
episodes.summary: Gamby gets unexpected company on spring break; Amanda is illuminated during a writer's retreat.

episodes.title: Venetian Nights
episodes.summary: Tensions between Gamby and Russell come to a head as prom night approaches.

episodes.title: The Union of the Wizard & The Warrior
episodes.summary: The school year comes to a startling end.
